section: Sustainable development - definition, Brundtland Report, SDGs and India's progress
subsections: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews
AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s: According to the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026, India secured which position, representing its highest-ever rank?
accepted.x: India was ranked 94th in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026, its highest-ever position.
accepted.tq: Use the precise current-affairs figure and distinguish it from the preceding year's rank.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: India's rank in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report improved from 99th in 2025 to 94th in 2026. This represents an improvement of:
accepted.x: India improved by five places, from 99th in 2025 to 94th in 2026.
accepted.tq: Subtract adjacent-year ranks rather than confusing the rank improvement with the longer-term gain.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's position in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026:
1. India ranked behind Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka.
2. India was found to be lagging on 13 of the 17 SDGs.
3. SDG 2 was identified as India's main area of concern.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. India ranked 94th, behind the four mentioned South Asian countries, lagged on 13 goals, and had SDG 2 as its principal concern.
accepted.tq: Check the complete set of country comparison, goal coverage and principal concern before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes India's performance in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2025?
o: India ranked 94th of 167 with a score of about 67 and entered the top 100 for the first time.
India ranked 71st of 167 with a score of about 99 and entered the top 75 for the first time.
India ranked 99th of 167 with a score of about 67 and entered the top 100 for the first time.
India ranked 99th of 166 with a score of about 71 and remained outside the top 100.
accepted.x: In the 2025 SDSN report, India ranked 99th out of 167, scored approximately 67, and entered the top 100 for the first time.
accepted.tq: Separate the report year, rank, denominator and score instead of carrying figures over from another index.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following countries occupied the top position in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2025?
accepted.x: Finland was the highest-ranked country in the 2025 SDSN Sustainable Development Report, followed by Sweden and Denmark.
accepted.tq: Identify the first item in a short ranked list before considering the other leading countries.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: India's first Voluntary National Review (VNR) on the Sustainable Development Goals was presented to the United Nations in:
accepted.x: India presented its first VNR to the United Nations in 2017.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the first reporting year from later VNR preparation and reporting years.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which set of Sustainable Development Goals was covered in India's first Voluntary National Review presented in 2017?
accepted.x: India's first VNR covered seven goals: SDGs 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 14 and 17.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure list membership and reject combinations containing substituted goal numbers.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Voluntary National Review for 2025 was prepared by:
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: India's 2025 VNR was prepared by NITI Aayog.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'who prepared or implemented it?' authority check to avoid institutional swaps.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Which of the following was identified as a success contributing to India's SDG performance in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026?
1. DBT-led reduction in multidimensional poverty
2. Rural electrification
3. Digital connectivity
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three were identified as areas of progress: DBT contributed to reducing multidimensional poverty, rural electrification supported SDG 7, and digital connectivity supported SDG 9.
accepted.tq: Match each achievement with the reported progress areas before choosing the complete combination.
accepted.sec: India's SDG progress - SDSN rank, Voluntary National Reviews  [other exams]

accepted.s: According to the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh was placed at which position among Indian States, with a score of 74?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh scored 74 and ranked ninth among Indian States in the SDG India Index 2023-24.
accepted.tq: Link the state score with its corresponding rank rather than confusing it with India's national score.
accepted.sec: AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s: A State scoring 74 in the SDG India Index 2023-24 would be placed in which category?
accepted.x: The Frontrunner category covers scores from 65 to 99; Andhra Pradesh's score of 74 therefore places it in that category.
accepted.tq: Apply the score band to the hypothetical state instead of relying on the label alone.
accepted.sec: AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding SDG Index performance categories and scores:
List-I (Category)
A. Achiever
B. Frontrunner
C. Performer
D. Aspirant

List-II (Score)
1. 0–49
2. 50–65
3. 65–99
4. 100

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: Achiever corresponds to 100, Frontrunner to 65–99, Performer to 50–65, and Aspirant to 0–49.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive end categories, 100 and 0–49, then complete the middle pairings.
accepted.sec: AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents Andhra Pradesh's relative performance across selected SDGs in the SDG India Index 2023-24?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first on SDG 7, second on SDG 14, third on SDG 1 and fourth on SDG 12.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of the ranked goals; reversed comparisons are the principal trap.
accepted.sec: AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s: Which Sustainable Development Goal saw Andhra Pradesh slip from 19th to 20th position and was identified as a concern?
accepted.x: SDG 4 was the area of concern, with Andhra Pradesh slipping from 19th to 20th position.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the concern indicator from the goals in which the State performed near the top.
accepted.sec: AP state SDG monitoring framework and district-level tracking

accepted.s: The SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026 was presented at which event?
o: World Sustainable Development Summit at New Delhi
United Nations Climate Change Conference at Dubai
accepted.x: The 2026 SDSN Sustainable Development Report was presented at the 3rd Hamburg Sustainability Conference.
accepted.tq: Use the event-location association and reject famous but unrelated international forums.

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh signed a Memorandum of Understanding with UN-Habitat for establishing a Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs in:
accepted.x: The proposed Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs is to be established in Amaravati under the MoU with UN-Habitat.
accepted.tq: Apply the location trap by distinguishing the named capital-region city from other prominent Andhra Pradesh cities.

accepted.s: The Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs proposed in Amaravati under the MoU with UN-Habitat is aligned primarily with:
accepted.x: The Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs is aligned with SDG 11, which concerns sustainable cities and communities.
accepted.tq: Infer the relevant goal from the precise subject of the initiative—urban affairs.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly reflects the current regional comparison of India's SDG performance?
o: India leads all smaller South Asian neighbours and is on track for every goal.
India trails smaller South Asian neighbours but is off track on only 3 goals.
India leads Bhutan and Nepal but trails only Sri Lanka on all 17 goals.
India trails smaller South Asian neighbours and is off track on 13 of the 17 goals.
accepted.x: India continues to trail smaller South Asian neighbours and is off track on 13 of the 17 SDGs.
accepted.tq: Find the option that preserves both parts of the comparison: regional standing and number of goals off track.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Brundtland Report — first definition of sustainable development; SDGs — target year 2040
Brundtland Report — first definition of sustainable development; SDGs — target year 2030
Brundtland Report — first definition of sustainable development in 1992; SDGs — target year 2030
Brundtland Report — first definition of sustainable development in 2015; SDGs — target year 2025
accepted.x: The Brundtland Report of 1987 is associated with the first definition of sustainable development, while the SDGs are intended to culminate in 2030.
accepted.tq: Separate the earlier conceptual milestone from the later SDG deadline and reject altered years.
